verdict.rationale: Docs show full phone number provisioning (via Retell numbers or SIP-trunked/imported numbers from Twilio/Telnyx/Vonage), assigning agents to numbers, and both inbound and outbound call handling (reserved inbound concurrency, outbound concurrency limits, DTMF for outbound IVR navigation), all accessible via official Node/Python SDKs, CLI, and webhooks for call events. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of the outbound/inbound API calls specifically (community evidence is about conversational quality, not API provisioning), and no visible OpenAPI/swagger spec to verify full endpoint coverage.
